2027 में कन्या राशि के लिए दो बड़े गोचर: In 2027, two big transits matter most for Virgo — Jupiter and Saturn. From January to June, Jupiter gives its best results in the 11th house — income rises, wishes come true, and there are gains through influential people and friends; there are also chances of marriage and children. From 26 June to 26 November, Jupiter in the 12th house increases expenses, travel and running around — spending on religious and good causes, and work linked to foreign lands may come up; pay attention to savings. From 26 November, Jupiter moves into Virgo, the 1st house from your sign.
3 जून तक और फिर 20 अक्टूबर से शनि सातवें: Until 3 June and again from 20 October, Saturn in the 7th house asks for patience in marriage and partnerships — keep expectations from your spouse low and read contracts carefully. From 3 June to 20 October, Saturn in Aries, the 8th house (Dhaiya), calls for care with health, sudden changes and obstacles — avoid risky ventures, borrowing and carelessness.
राहु पाँचवें भाव में सट्टा, जुआ और प्रेम: Rahu in the 5th house advises avoiding speculation, gambling and confusion in love. Ketu in the 11th house brings sudden gains and fulfilled wishes — a good position.
